tools.name: get_griddo_editor_doc
tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown of one Griddo backoffice (Author Experience) documentation page by its path, as returned by search_griddo_editor_docs or list_griddo_editor_docs. Use it when the search excerpt is not enough to answer accurately.

tools.name: list_griddo_editor_docs
tools.description: List every page of the Griddo backoffice (Author Experience) documentation, grouped by section, with title and URL. Use it to get oriented before searching, or when the user asks what the documentation covers.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_griddo_editor_docs" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the official Griddo documentation for content authors and site administrators (the Griddo backoffice, Author Experience: pages, modules, templates, conte…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
